Direction convention for vassal events: the schema says vassal_start's counterpart is the vassal (so the suzerain records it); the review asked for the vassal's side and boii, aetolian-league and others record it that way. Cappadocia (95 BC-AD 17) and Nabataea (62 BC-106) now record it on their own side as well as on roman-republic and roman-empire; the renderer or the matrix must not draw the tint twice.
